title: Massachusetts transfer of prescriptions
rule_summary: Prescription transfers must comply with 247 CMR 9.14, applicable controlled-substance limits, pharmacist-to-pharmacist communication requirements, and required record annotations.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply transfer requirements requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing transfer requirements with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
